fifteen courses. Generated from front-matter scans (3 representative

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR

  ROOT --> W[Writing]
  ROOT --> M[mediation Sprachmittlung]
  ROOT --> LA[Language awareness]
  ROOT --> IC[Intercultural]
```
